captions.detailed: A flat, circular belt pulley featuring a central mounting hole and a series of weight-reduction cutouts. The cutouts are arranged in two concentric radial patterns, resembling stylized petals: an inner ring of six large elongated oval slots and an outer ring of six smaller oval slots rotated halfway between the inner ones. The outer rim of the pulley has a recessed channel (groove) bounded by raised lips to guide and keep a drive belt in place.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric belt pulley with weight-reduction cutouts. The script should allow users to configure the pulley diameter, belt width, center screw hole diameter, lip height, and lip thickness, while generating a pattern of stylized oval cutouts arranged in one or two concentric radial rings around the center hub.
captions.factory: The pulley is constructed by unioning several cylinders to form the main body, including the main pulley wheel, the bottom lip, the top lip, and a transitional conical section (using cylinder with r1 and r2) to create a sloped profile. A central cylindrical hole is subtracted from this assembly. A custom 'holes' module calculates positions and uses a for-loop with 'rotate', 'translate', and 'scale' transformations on cylinders to subtract the petal-shaped oval cutouts in one or two concentric rings.
